'''Genstat (General Statistics)''' is a [[List of statistical packages|statistical software package]] with [[data analysis]] capabilities, particularly in the field of [[agriculture]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.agronomix.com/Corporate/GenStat.aspx|title=AGRONOMIX Software inc., Software for plant breeding|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170206204003/http://www.agronomix.com/Corporate/GenStat.aspx|archivedate=2017-02-06}}</ref><ref name=warwick>{{Cite web|url=https://warwick.ac.uk/services/od/ras/opportunities/development_support/mathstats/additional_resources/software_list/genstat|title=GenStat (General Statistical)|website=The University of Warwick}}</ref> It was developed in 1968 by the [[Rothamsted Research]] in the United Kingdom and was designed to provide [[modular design]], linear [[mixed model]]s<ref>{{Cite book|title=Mixed Models and Multilevel Data Structures in Agriculture}}</ref>{{page needed|date=July 2021}} and graphical functions.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Gower|first=John C.|date=2015|title=The Development of Statistical Computing at Rothamsted|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/44162829|journal=International Statistical Review |volume=83|issue=3|pages=357–370|doi=10.1111/insr.12093 |jstor=44162829 |s2cid=122657943 |issn=0306-7734|url-access=subscription}}</ref> It was developed and distributed by VSN International (VSNi),<ref>{{cite web|url=https://bbsrc.ukri.org/documents/vsni-spinout-pdf/|title=Statistics software success for spinout company VSN international|website=[[Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council]]|date=6 November 2023 }}</ref> which was owned by The [[Numerical Algorithms Group]] and Rothamsted Research.

__NOTOC__

Genstat is used in a number of research areas, including [[plant science]], [[forestry]], [[animal science]], and [[medicine]].<ref name=warwick/>

== See also ==
* [[ASReml]]: a statistical package which fits linear mixed models to large data sets with complex variance models, using Residual Maximum Likelihood (REML)
